title: lotus creticus subsp. salzmannii
intro: Lotus creticus subsp. salzmannii, commonly known as Cretan lotus or Cretan sea lotus, is a perennial plant native to the Mediterranean region, belonging to the Lotus genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lotus creticus subsp. salzmannii include wound healing, antiseptic effects, and the treatment of digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
